description: de_static_str leaks every deserialized string permanently via Box::leak. DeviatedFinding uses this on lint_id and citation; EvaluationReport serde pulls in all findings and deviated_findings. A tool that deserializes corpus-scale JSON reports in a loop will grow memory without bound. Fix: switch lint_id/citation in Finding and DeviatedFinding to String, or use a thread-local interning map bounded by the number of unique lint IDs (small and finite). File: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs lines 125-132.
title: pkix-lint: de_static_str leak unbounded for batch deserialization
